---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the result you want and how it would help.

## Alternatives

Describe approaches you have considered and their tradeoffs.

## Scope

Mention any expected interface, dependency or permission changes. Use placeholders
for private values; do not include credentials, pairing data or phone content.
